concerns.text: T014 depends on T011 (ENCODE/Roadmap regulatory BED fetch) and T018 depends on T010b (reference genome fetch), but neither T011 nor T010b appears as a task in this document — they exist only as names in the 'Revision behavior' note. FR-001's regulatory-region download and the reference-genome acquisition needed for PWM scoring have no executable task, deliverables, or verification criteria. Add task definitions (or fold them into T014/T018 with explicit fetch steps and source_log entries).

concerns.location: tasks.md vs spec.md:US-1 Scenario 2 / plan.md fetch_motifs.py
concerns.text: No task fetches the JASPAR 2024 human PWM file. T018 and T021 load 'data/raw/jaspar_pwm.txt' but no task downloads it, records its URL/version/checksum in source_log.txt, or parses/stores matrices with IDs and lengths (US-1 scenario 2, plan's fetch_motifs.py). Add a JASPAR ingestion task.

US-3 acceptance scenario 3 (a known disease-associated TF such as TCF7L2 must return a significant corrected p-value, validating true-positive detection) has no implementing task; T024's synthetic unit test covers only the generic enrichment case. Add a task or extend T024/T025 to demonstrate this acceptance criterion.

concerns.location: tasks.md vs contracts/dataset_schema.schema.yaml / plan.md LD pruning
concerns.text: The dataset schema requires ld_block_id and stratum_id fields, and plan.md's Complexity Tracking lists 'LD Pruning & Stratification' as a managed element, but no task computes LD blocks, strata, or performs LD pruning. Either add a task or explicitly descope these fields (and update the schema/plan) — currently the schema T014/T021 outputs against cannot be satisfied.

Plan's 'dual-test strategy' includes a Tail-Enrichment Test, and enrichment_result_schema requires tail_proportion_observed, tail_p_value, is_significant_tail — but T024/T025 implement only the KS + West-Stephens path. Either add a task covering the tail test or reconcile the plan/contract to remove it; as written, T025 cannot conform to the schema it names.

T025 claims to include 'enrichment ratios of high-impact SNPs in GWAS loci vs expected overlap (SC-003)' while conforming to enrichment_result_schema.schema.yaml, but that schema has no observed_overlap/expected_overlap/enrichment_ratio fields (they live in the conflicting enrichment_schema/result_schema files). The SC-003 evidence has no schema home; specify which schema T025 actually validates against and that it can express SC-003's ratio.

Tasks reference 'specs/001-gene-regulation/contracts/...' but the actual contract files live under specs/001-systematic-assessment-of-non-coding-vari/contracts/. Fix the paths so schema validation is executable.

US-1 scenario 3 requires exclusion of non-human-species variants; T014 filters only MAF and ACGT alleles. Likely benign for the human-only dbSNP path, but add a one-line note in T014 (or descope in spec) so the acceptance criterion is verifiable.
